text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Please check these over.
This time, you left six pieces of jewelry, a pedestal,
and two pieces of goldwork in our care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm at a jewelry shop.
The gems I received from the clerk
are ornaments for Orfevre's racing outfit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened one day after I had signed a contract with Orfevre and had grown quite accustomed to serving her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For some reason, I found myself being dragged
through an ultra-luxury department store
by Orfevre and Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That tailor over there has been a family favorite for generations.
Not only is the fabric of supreme quality, but the comfort is simply unmatched.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, that tea specialty shop over there carries Orfevre's favorite tea leaves.
Please keep that in mind, if you'd like.
choice_data_list: Ah, I see. I'll keep that in mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since earlier, they've been giving me an explanation every time one of their favorite shops comes into view.
Why the sudden tour...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Over this way, Trainer.
choice_data_list: A jewelry store? ...Is this our destination?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I came to retrieve what was left in my care.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome.
—Ah, Lady Dream Journey.
I shall prepare your item. Please, step inside.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Please, take a look and confirm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the clerk presented with refined gestures was
familiar jewelry and goldwork—
...Could this be... for her racing outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You're quite quick on the uptake, as expected.
Just as you guessed, it's an accessory for Orfe's racing racewear.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've been on close terms with this shop for a long time.
Their discerning eye and their skill are both truly reliable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Maintenance is crucial for both jewels and goldwork.
Especially on a racing outfit... When dealing with stubborn stains,
it's best to let a professional polish it up.
choice_data_list: You really take meticulous care of it...
You really take meticulous care of it, don't you...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Naturally, it is of utmost importance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —That was the true formal attire of a "King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“And it is also the symbol of my path of conquest.
Therefore—it must always shine brilliantly.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We were extraordinarily selective with both design and materials.
To ensure it was worthy of Orfevre the 'King',
we gathered candidates from all over.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre's discerning eye in choosing the absolute best among them
was truly that of a 'King'—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I pulled every string to gather the absolute finest materials...
Except for the goldwork used in the decorations, which I asked my father to craft.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is only natural to place your commission with the finest artisan.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think so too.
Thanks to that, it turned into a truly wonderful racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to their conversation, you could tell how much care
Orfevre put into making the racing racewear,
and how much emotion went into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, it offered a glimpse into
the deep bond of trust unique to family—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Keep that in mind as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What are you dazing off for?
choice_data_list: Um... what do you mean by memorize...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The location of this shop. The types of accessories that need maintenance.
Checklist items for when requesting and picking up orders, and so forth.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Everything Or wears... especially her racing silk, must be
managed by someone exceptionally trustworthy.
That is why... as her older sister, I handle it all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "However, there may be times when I am absent in the future. In preparation for such occasions, I would like you to gradually learn the management methods as well."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
As my loyal retainer, manage it properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “—You're entrusting this to me? To think you'd give such an important task to me... Just that alone makes my heart swell.”
choice_data_list: I'll do my duty with everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Heh. Keep up the good work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Since then, I've grown quite used to managing her accessories.
I take the accessories and racing outfit I just received and bring them to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Mm. Very good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am not yet trusted enough to handle everything.
As a subject, I am only halfway along the path. Even so... to bear a part of the management fills me with unexpected joy.
choice_data_list: Thanks for trusting me with this.
I'll do my best to earn your trust even more.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Discerning the abilities and loyalty of one's subjects
and assigning them fitting duties is the responsibility of a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I am merely assigning work befitting her capabilities. —It is not out of kindness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Looked at another way, this must mean
they acknowledge my work.
—I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...What are you doing? Do you intend to claim
you can shoulder everything like my sister does? —How insolent."
choice_data_list: Ah, no, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I frantically explain that I was just expressing my enthusiasm.
—To which, for some reason, a sudden smile crosses her face.
Did that mean... I hadn't upset her after all?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Very well. Bear in mind that whatever authority
you are granted will depend entirely on your own performance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I expect your continued, faithful service.
